name: The American Club
summary: Full-facility membership club in Claymore with dining, sport, kids’ programming, and holiday camps — the default Orchard-fringe family comparison point.
body: The American Club is a default comparison point for family memberships: pool, fitness, F&B, kids’ programming, holiday camps, and a dense events calendar in a Claymore / Orchard-fringe location. Relocating households often use it as a third place while a trailing partner’s job search runs — but entrance fees still need cost-per-use maths against ANZA/AWA and ActiveSG. It suits households already living River Valley / Orchard / some Tanglin patterns who will use the club midweek, not only on showcase Saturdays. Waitlists and entrance fees are real — treat joining as a housing-adjacent decision, not an impulse add-on after a welcome tour. Ask HR about corporate seats before paying personally. Tour at your actual use times; compare against Tanglin Club (heritage/scarcity) and Hollandse Club (often stronger facilities-to-fee for Bukit Timah lives). Junior arts and family performance calendars are a membership-tier belonging rail alongside youth theatre/dance studios outside the club.
membershipNotes: Entrance fees + monthly dues + possible F&B minimums; ask about current waitlist by membership category, corporate transfer rules, and school-break camp calendars.
